utility.notes: Rancho Cordova is confirmed as an SMUD-served city, corroborated by multiple sources this session including SMUD's own SB379-adjacent municipal code chapter references and general knowledge that Rancho Cordova is within SMUD's core Sacramento County service territory alongside the City of Sacramento, Elk Grove, and Citrus Heights.

value.name: Sacramento Municipal Utility District (SMUD)
value.notes: SMUD is a vertically-integrated municipal utility — it generates/procures and delivers its own power rather than sitting alongside a separate CCA, consistent with the pattern already established for other SMUD-territory records this session.
